title: Historical DPWH project allocations associated with named barangays
source: Integrated historical DPWH project-family series and official-barangay MPB series, FY2015–FY2026

summary.caveat: A line naming multiple barangays is associated with each named place at its full allocation; place totals overlap. Non-MPB rows are limited to uniquely assigned rows in the district historical series and use title-parsed locality context. MPB rows use the separate official-barangay matcher. Allocations are not payments or verified construction.
